# Contributing

This guide applies to gaato's repositories that do not have their own
`CONTRIBUTING.md`.

Issues and pull requests of any size are welcome, in English or Japanese. If
you are unsure, send it anyway.

## Issues

Say what you did, what you expected and what happened. A version and a small
reproduction help but are not required, and what you found about the cause is
welcome too.

## Pull requests

Small fixes can come straight in. Drafts and unfinished code are fine. If the
idea is right, I may finish it myself; you stay credited as author or
co-author. Keep "Allow edits by maintainers" checked so I can push to your
branch.

Each repository's README, and its `AGENTS.md` where there is one, say how to
build and test it.

AI tools are fine; check what you send.

Contributions are accepted under the license of the repository.

## Security

Report vulnerabilities privately from the repository's **Security** tab
(**Report a vulnerability**), not in a public issue.
